records.prompt: A difficult exam is a week away. How do you spend that week?

options.text: Study a little every day.

records.prompt: When a subject fascinates you, can you give it your full attention?

Around the halfway mark.

The smaller parcel.

options.text: Blueberries, chicken, and bananas!
